2. The plaintiff instituted the suit on the allegations inter alia that the property in suit measuring 4.25 acres of land in seven plots appertaining to five different khatians belonged to defendant Nos. 1 and 2 by way of inheritance. They were in possession of the, suit land in assertion of their title thereto. Defendant Nos. 1 and 2 entered into a contract with the plaintiff on the 9th of January, 1969 for sale of the said property to the plaintiff for a consideration of Taka 15,500/-. On the same day defendant Nos. 1 and 2, on receipt of an amount of Taka 13,500/- as earnest money, executed a baina patra in favour of the plaintiff. The said baina patra was written by Abdul Hamid and attested by Golam Zilani and Arkan Ali. Defendant Nos. 1 and 2 made over the title deeds along with possession of the suit land in favour of the plaintiff in part performance of the contract. Accordingly the plaintiff came in possession and has been continuing in possession. It was Stipulated in the baina patra that defendant Nos. 1 and 2 would execute, and register an appropriate deed of conveyance in favour of the plaintiff within December, 1967. It was further stipulated that in the event of plaintiff's failure to pay the balance of consideration money within the stipulated time and to get a kabala executed and registered by the defendants, the amount of earnest money shall stand forfeited and the contract lapsed. The defendants did nothing to perform their part of the contract and the plaintiff had to file an application before the Member, Board of Revenue of the then East Pakistan for, permission to file a suit for specific performance of contract against defendant Nos. 1 and 2. On that application case No. 7363 of 1967 was started but the same ultimately abated because of the lapse of the East Pakistan Disturbed Persons (Rehabilitation), Ordinance, 1964. Thereafter defendant Nos. 1 and 2 refused to execute and register the kabala Inspite of repeated demands of the plaintiff. On 15.5.69 defendants Nos. 1 and 2 finally refused to execute and register the kabala Hence the suit. 

 4. On the application of the plaintiff defendant No. 3 was subsequently added as a defendant in the suit on the allegation inter alia that she purchased one acre of land out of 1.07 acres of plot No. 1591 of khatian No. 229 with the knowledge of the contract with the plaintiff.
